svg.aria-label: U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve — Line diagram
svg.style: background: rgb(236, 239, 244); font-family: Inter, system-ui, Avenir, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
svg.desc: Line chart of Million Barrels over 49 points, from '77 to '25; values range from 7 to 727.
